summary: Verified all 3 code-fixable bugs (FIX 1+2 backend Razorpay CSP, FIX 5 frontend '+→Decider' route, FIX 3 frontend Step-5 saved-templates list, FIX 4 frontend TemplateLibrary 'Mine' visibility badges). ALL PASS. (1+2) curl against PUBLIC EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL for GET /api/ai-wallet/refill/checkout and GET /api/subscriptions/checkout both return HTTP 200, content-type text/html, and a route-scoped 'content-security-policy' header listing `script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://checkout.razorpay.com https://*.razorpay.com` AND `frame-src https://*.razorpay.com https://api.razorpay.com` — confirmed Razorpay checkout script is no longer blocked. (5) From /prr, tapping the top-right pink '+' opens the new-menu modal showing Decider/Pros&Cons/SWOT/Test123; tapping 'Decider' navigates to /tools/new-decision?module=dezider with the 5-circle step indicator (1,2,3,4,5) and Step 1 title 'Choose Life Area' — NOT the legacy /prr/new 10-step page. (3) After completing Step-1 (Career) → Step-2 (Individual) → Step-3 (Problem) → Step-4 (no sub-area, no title) → 'Find Templates', Step-5 renders a 'Your saved templates (10)' section that lists every owned template with both a template-type cue and a visibility badge ('Public' for the 5 BadgeCheck templates, 'Private' for the 5 T-* templates). Tapping '[Private-Template] T-options' fires POST /api/templates/{id}/use 200 and navigates to /prr/04511307-f976-4894-8dc9-2f37dd18810e (the decision editor at Step 6/10 'Define Options' opened correctly). (4) Template Library modal opened from /prr header bookmark icon at (316,30) — 'Mine 10' tab shows each card with a visibility badge ('Public' or 'Private') rendered next to the template-type badge — verified for all 10 cards (5 Public + 5 Private). The 'Shared' label code path is identical to Private/Public (lines 393-395) but no shared templates exist in current seed data to render that specific label live.
action_items: None — all 4 user-reported fixes verified working. The 2 Razorpay-related items not testable beyond CSP whitelist verification require live test keys to drive an end-to-end payment, which is out of scope per the agent-to-agent context note.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/core/hardening.py L66-77: RAZORPAY_CSP constant correctly whitelists checkout.razorpay.com in script-src AND *.razorpay.com in frame-src/child-src/connect-src — covers the SDK iframe + lumberjack analytics. Good defence-in-depth (only loosens CSP for the 2 hosted /checkout pages, global stays strict via line 51-61).

backend/core/hardening.py L100-118: SecurityHeadersMiddleware uses setdefault for Content-Security-Policy AND reads `response.headers.get('Content-Security-Policy', CSP_POLICY)` as the default — this is precisely what makes the route-scoped header in ai_wallet.py:366 / subscriptions.py:527 win. Verified live via curl.
backend/routes/ai_wallet.py L351-366 and subscriptions.py L516-527: HTMLResponse(headers={'Content-Security-Policy': RAZORPAY_CSP}) — same pattern in both, consistent.
frontend/app/(tabs)/prr.tsx L507: router.push('/tools/new-decision?module=dezider') — confirmed routing to the new 5-step wizard; legacy /prr/new is no longer referenced from the Decider menu item.

frontend/app/tools/new-decision.tsx L203 + L687-714: my_templates fetched and rendered with vis-badge mapping (private=#6B7280 / shared=#3B82F6 / public=#F59E0B). Tap handler at L211 calls POST /api/templates/{id}/use and navigates via router.replace(`/prr/${decisionId}`). Clean, matches the visibility scheme used in TemplateBrowserModal.

frontend/src/components/TemplateBrowserModal.tsx L386-410: visibility badge rendered inside the 'Mine' tab card body using the same colour palette as new-decision.tsx — DRY-ish but the mapping is duplicated rather than extracted into a shared util. Minor maintenance nit, no functional bug.
